introduction.purpose: This document specifies the requirements for the 'My to do' web application, a task management tool for the general public. It serves as a complete description of the system's behavior and constraints.
introduction.document_conventions: Requirements are written in natural language with 'shall' indicating mandatory conditions. Priority levels are: High, Medium, Low.

product_scope.summary: The 'My to do' application allows users to create, manage, and track personal tasks through a web interface, with user authentication and data persistence.
goals: Deliver the primary My to do. user workflow through a web application.
Support scalable growth with modular MERN microservices.
business_objectives: Reduce manual effort in the primary business process.

product_perspective.system_context: The application is a standalone web-based task management system designed for individual use, with a React frontend and Node.js/Express backend microservices using MongoDB for data storage.

user_classes_and_characteristics.characteristics: General public users with basic web literacy, needing to manage personal tasks efficiently.

overall_description.operating_environment: Web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) on desktop and mobile devices; backend hosted on cloud servers (e.g., AWS, Heroku).
design_and_implementation_constraints: Must use Node.js and Express for backend microservices
overall_description.assumptions_and_dependencies: Assumes users have stable internet access; depends on MongoDB cloud service availability and modern web browser compatibility.

user_interfaces.name: Web Interface
user_interfaces.description: Responsive React-based UI with forms for task management and authentication, following modern design principles.

hardware_interfaces: None required beyond standard web server and client hardware

software_interfaces.name: MongoDB Database
software_interfaces.description: NoSQL database for storing user accounts and task data.

communications_interfaces: RESTful APIs over HTTPS for frontend-backend communication

performance_requirements: All API responses must be delivered within 2 seconds under normal load conditions.
safety_requirements: None beyond general software safety best practices
security_requirements: User passwords must be hashed and salted before storage.
API endpoints must validate user authentication tokens.
software_quality_attributes: Usability: Intuitive UI for non-technical users
business_rules: Each user can only access their own tasks.
Tasks must have a non-empty title.

database_requirements: Use MongoDB with collections for users and tasks.
Implement indexes on user_id for efficient task queries.
legal_requirements: Comply with basic data protection principles; store minimal personal data (email).
reuse_objectives: Microservices designed for potential reuse in other applications

glossary.definition: A user-created item representing something to be done, with a title and optional description.
